p: came he to Derbe and Lystra: Paul himself does not receive Timothy into the ministry without sufficient testimony, and permission of the brethren.
Jewess: Paul, in his second epistle to Timothy, commends the godliness of Timothy's mother and grandmother.
well reported of by the brethren: Both for his godliness and honesty.
Him would Paul have to go: Timothy is circumcised, not simply for any necessity, but in respect of the time only, in order to win the Jews.
And as they went through the: Charity is to be observed in things indifferent so that regard is had both of the weak, and of the peace of the Church.
decrees for to keep: These decrees which he spoke of in the former chapter.
Now when they had gone throughout: God appoints certain and determinate times to open and set forth his truth, so that both the election and the calling may proceed of grace.
forbidden of the Holy Ghost to: He does not show why they were forbidden, but only that they were forbidden, teaching us to obey and not to enquire.
And a vision appeared to Paul: They are the ministers of the Gospel by whom he helps those who are likely to perish.
And after he had seen the: The Saints did not easily believe every vision.
And on the sabbath we went: God begins his kingdom in Macedonia by the conversion of a woman, and so shows that there is no exception of persons in the Gospel.
prayer was wont to be made: Where they customarily assembled themselves.
And a certain woman named Lydia: The Lord opens the heart to hear the word which is preached.
And when she was baptized: An example of a godly housewife.
And it came to pass: Satan transforms himself into an angel of light, and covets to enter by undermining, but Paul openly stops him, and casts him out.
divination met us: This is a sure sign of the god Apollo, who would give answers to those that asked him.
many days: Paul made no haste to do this miracle, for he did all things only as he was led by the Spirit.
And when her masters saw that: Covetousness of evil gain and of profit is an occasion for persecuting the truth. In the meanwhile, God sparing Timothy, calls Paul and Silas as the stronger to battle.
And brought them to the magistrates: Covetousness pretends a desire for common peace and godliness.
And teach customs: It is an argument of the devil to use the authority of ancestors, though not distinguishing exactly which ancestors.
And the multitude rose up together: An example of evil magistrates, to obey the fury and rage of the people.
fast in the stocks: Because he wanted to be more sure that they did not escape, he set them fast in the stocks.
And at midnight Paul and Silas: The prayers of the godly do shake both heaven and earth.

And the keeper of the prison: The merciful Lord, as often as he desires, draws men to life even through the midst of death, and whereas they justly deserved great punishment, he shows them great mercy.
But Paul cried with a loud: In means which are especially extraordinary, we should not move our foot forward, unless God goes before us.
And he took them the same: God with the very same hand wounds and heals when it pleases him.
And when it was day: Shame and confusion is in due time the reward of wicked and unjust magistrates.

But Paul said unto them: We must not render injury for injury, and yet nonetheless it is lawful for us to use such helps as God gives us, to bridle the outrageousness of the wicked, so that they do not hurt others in a similar way.
And the serjeants told these words: The wicked are not moved with the fear of God, but with the fear of men: and by that means also God provides for his, when it is needed.
And they went out of the: We may avoid dangers in such a way that we never neglect our duty.
